name: Cheesy Zucchini Fritters with Lime Crema & Mexican "Street Corn" Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
3 limes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Transfer to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture and set aside.
Zest and juice limes. Divide between a small and large bowl. Add yogurt and spices to the small bowl, then whisk to combine the lime crema. Set aside. (Reserve large bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the large bowl with the lime along with additional yogurt, mayo, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate mozzarella. Place in another large bowl along with eggs and spices. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (8 oz) block mozzarella cheese
3 eggs
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated zucchini. Transfer to the bowl with the mozzarella mixture, along with flour, and stir once more to combine the batter.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-low heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful of green onions for serving).

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ cups frozen corn
1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and fritters between plates or bowls. Top fritters with lime crema and reserved green onions. Enjoy!
